summary: Tested all 4 Obserra v1 features (Drill Trend Chart, Proof Link QR, Slack/Teams no-op Proof Post, Control Assurance page). Found and fixed a critical ReferenceError in DefensibilityDashboard.jsx (avgSus/avgRes used but never defined) which was crashing KillReplayDrillCard entirely and blocking Defensibility tab. Also removed a duplicated fire-drill-trend block (would have violated unique data-testid). After the fix, all 4 features work end-to-end: (1) fire-drill-trend renders with rate pill, avg suspend/resume pills, sparkline, and assurance link; running a drill increments the list from 3 -> 4 rows and rate stays at 100% control-confirmed. (2) proof-of-control-btn opens the result banner with a real <svg> QR (proof-of-control-qr) beside proof-of-control-url = https://.../audit-room/UxKT1G2IqUBEeHpZGvfjew. (3) POST /api/agents/runtime/fire-drill returns HTTP 200 with a full drill payload even though no Slack/Teams webhook is configured (chat post is a safe no-op). (4) /app/control-assurance loads with all KPI tiles populated (100%, streak 4, avg suspend 478ms/resume 578ms, 4 total drills), monthly pass-rate BarChart, response-time LineChart, ca-recent-list with ca-recent-0, and ca-refresh works.

ui_bugs.issue: ReferenceError: avgSus is not defined (also avgRes). Variables were referenced on lines 523-524 and 544-545 without ever being computed, causing the whole card to crash with an Uncaught runtime error and preventing use of the Defensibility tab (fire-drill trend + proof-of-control button). Also the trend block was duplicated (two adjacent <div data-testid="fire-drill-trend">). Fixed in this iteration by wrapping trend block in an IIFE that computes avgSus/avgRes from drills and removing the duplicate. Main agent should verify the fix aligns with intended design.

issues: React hydration warning: <span> is rendered inside <option> (via ve-dynamic instrumentation) in the fire-drill-agent select — console warning only, not blocking.

action_items: Review the avgSus/avgRes fix in DefensibilityDashboard.jsx (lines ~518-540) — testing agent applied a minimal IIFE fix; confirm the intended design (are averages meant to be all-time drills or last N?) matches.
Confirm the trend block should only appear once (duplicate was removed).
critical_code_review_comments: DefensibilityDashboard.jsx had a duplicated 20-line trend block — indicates an accidental copy/paste; add lint rule to catch duplicate data-testid.
avgSus/avgRes ReferenceError should have been caught by a smoke test on Defensibility tab load before shipping.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing drills; ran one additional fire-drill during test (list grew 3 -> 4).
context_for_next_testing_agent: The Defensibility tab was blocked by ReferenceError avgSus (and duplicate fire-drill-trend div). Fixed by testing agent. If regressions, look at DefensibilityDashboard.jsx around lines 518-540 (IIFE computing avgSus/avgRes). All other features verified live against backend at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.
rca of the issue: avgSus/avgRes were referenced in JSX to render pill badges for average suspend/resume ms in the drill-trend block, but the const declarations were never added. Additionally the whole trend <div data-testid="fire-drill-trend"> block was pasted twice. On mount, KillReplayDrillCard threw ReferenceError, tripping the runtime error overlay and hiding the entire Defensibility tab (including proof-of-control-btn). Fix: compute avgSus/avgRes inline from drills[].suspend_ms/resume_ms via an IIFE and delete the duplicated block.
